items.text: **Welcome to the great Copilot Chat journey: Prompt like an expert!**

Welcome to Week 2, and get ready to unlock the full potential of Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat! 
 This week we're discovering how Copilot Chat can **boost your work and save valuable time by summarizing long documents and creating first drafts.**.

Want to see what Copilot Chat can do?
Try these prompts and get started right away. For the best experience, focus on one prompt per day and use it multiple times throughout your workday.

[✨ *Create a blog post about [topic]. Be sure to include an engaging headline and a call to action at the end.*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)

[✨ *Come up with three ideas for products merging technology and [capability], and provide a sample business plan for each.*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)

[✨ *Suggest ways to make this presentation more engaging while staying professional (e.g., clearer story, stronger hooks, simpler visuals, and one light, appropriate moment if relevant).*](https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/entity1-d870f6cd-4aa5-4d42-9626-)
